summary: Built-in image/video edit Generators backed by one realm-neutral Asset Action PluginModule.
context_hints: Image Editor and Video Clipper share the semantic module in @clash/shared-runtime; do not fork their invocation or lifecycle by runtime
local, cloud, and client are Host-private execution realms, never Generator identity or persisted Action parameters
Every edit publishes a new immutable Asset; the Host owns OutputCommit publication and Canvas projection

subdirectories.generators: Native image-editor and video-clipper Generator definitions.
subdirectories.src: Local media adapter plugged into the realm-neutral shared PluginModule.
subdirectories.dist: Generated standalone stdio compatibility artifact; never hand-edit.

key_files.manifest.json: Bundled Generator and Action exports plus source media delivery contracts.
key_files.src/stdio.ts: Node media adapter and direct-execution stdio compatibility entrypoint. Checks crop/frame/trim bounds against decoded source facts; video trims preserve source variable-frame-rate timestamps instead of synthesizing nominal-rate frames.
key_files.src/variable-frame-rate.test.ts: Real FFmpeg/ffprobe regression compares trimmed frame timestamps to the corresponding source interval.
